create_ACTLayer: create an ACTLayer instance with a gym action space, input dimension, orthogonal init flag, gain, and device
run_ACTLayer_forward: run the ACTLayer forward pass to compute actions and log probabilities from input tensor x
run_ACTLayer_get_probs: run the ACTLayer get_probs method to compute action probabilities from input tensor x
run_ACTLayer_evaluate_actions: run the ACTLayer evaluate_actions method to compute log probabilities and entropy for given actions
review_ACTLayer_evaluate_actions: review the ACTLayer evaluate_actions method for mixed action space log probability and entropy computation
